route.rationale: Multi-slice program, not one demoable change: 2 engines x (conformance + repo-to-PR E2E), workspace isolation decision (Q9), versioned workspace store (G2), takeover/settle across 4 unguarded handlers (G1), reconnectable terminals via adapter-kit extension (G7), then continuity/checkpoints/budgets; web first, CLI+mobile completeness sequenced after (A4). Builder slice 1 = web repo-to-PR on normal Pi; slice 2 = isolation + checkpoint restore.
